_description: The Stanford Dragon as clear glass (dielectric ior 1.5) standing in a real sunset environment (equirectangular sky.png) on a dark glossy floor. The sky is refracted through the glass body and reflected on the floor. Dramatic warm key + cool rim light.

lights._comment: cool rim, behind-left high — separates dragon from the stars

objects._comment: === DARK GLOSSY FLOOR — reflects the dragon and the sunset ===
=== EMISSIVE SOFTBOX PANELS — bright shapes the chrome reflects + real illumination ===
warm KEY orb — bright emissive sphere front-right, just outside frame. Lights the dragon's right side and appears as a warm round highlight in the chrome.
cool FILL orb — bright emissive sphere front-left, just outside frame.
glowing moon, high behind — bright disc in the starfield, reflected by chrome
=== GLASS DRAGON — raw y in [-0.283,0.422] (h=0.705). scale 7 -> h=4.94. Lift bottom to floor: y = 0.283*7 = 1.98 ===
